draft.title: draft
draft.note: Makeshift draft — assign two skills to each King and Champion. The real Stack M draft (alternating picks, possible simultaneous-reveal per OQ-62, pre-made loadouts per OQ-65) lands later as its own slice.

hook.name: Hook
hook.desc: Pull target enemy 1 tile toward caster. Target takes 1 damage.

break.name: Break
break.desc: Remove 1 armor from target. If target has 0 armor and Charge is staged, deals 1 HP damage instead.

steal.name: Steal
steal.desc: Deal 1 damage to target. Caster gains 1 money; target loses 1 money.

tempest.name: Tempest
tempest.desc: Target takes 1 damage. Pieces in the ring around the target are pushed 1 tile outward. Caster is unaffected.

dash.name: Dash
dash.desc: Move self up to 2 tiles along the Path.

blast.name: Blast
blast.desc: Push target enemy 1 tile away from caster (direction implied by caster→target line).

shove.name: Shove
shove.desc: Push target enemy 1 tile in a chosen direction.

swap.name: Swap
swap.desc: Swap positions with an allied piece. Requires an unobstructed Path.

retreat.name: Retreat
retreat.desc: Move self along the Path to a square adjacent to one of your Guards.

focus.name: Focus
focus.desc: This turn, one non-mystic skill used by any of your pieces gains +1 Range. For Move skills, you choose whether +1 applies to activation range or effect range.

charge.name: Charge
charge.desc: This turn, one Strike skill used by any of your pieces deals +1 damage.

endphase.name: End Phase
endphase.desc: End the Skill Phase. Unspent actions are forfeit.

wheel.focusStaged: Focus is staged — one non-mystic skill of yours this turn gains +1 Range (for Move skills, you pick activation- or effect-range).
wheel.chargeStaged: Charge is staged — one Strike skill used by any of your pieces this turn deals +1 damage.

sandbox.confirmDiscard: Discard {n} sandbox move(s) and return to the true position?
